prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1172; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I observed two vehicles with heavy front-end and side damage at the center of the roadway. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that he was proceeding straight through the intersection when Driver 2, a pickup truck traveling southbound, began a left turn across his path. Driver 2 stated that he had a green signal but failed to yield to oncoming traffic before completing the turn. A passenger riding in Driver 1's vehicle was seated in the front seat and reported no injuries at the scene. Driver 1 complained of head pain and dizziness and reported that he had been struck in the head by the airbag and had lost consciousness briefly, consistent with a concussion. Driver 1 was transported by EMS for evaluation. Both vehicles were towed from the scene. Citations and final determination of fault are pending review of witness statements and signal timing records.
